what_it_does: Modern gaming CPUs run very fast, and when many cores work at peak power at the same moment, the electrical current demanded can spike and damage the power management circuit. This chip adds tiny sensors directly on the processor die to measure power consumption in real time, then uses machine learning trained on actual silicon data to predict and prevent power spikes. The CPU then automatically spreads computation work across its cores based on available power budget, preventing the system from crashing or throttling down.
